premise: For any binary option event E with payout $1.00, YES_ask + NO_ask <= 1.00 in absence of arbitrage.
Any sequence of transactions yielding a net positive credit with non-negative terminal payoff is a riskless arbitrage.
A transaction-costless bid/ask inversion across exchanges (Bid_A > Ask_B) implies pure cross-venue arbitrage.
In a mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive partition of N event outcomes, sum(ask_i) <= 100¢.
For call binary options on the same underlying, ask price must be monotonically non-increasing with strike price.
